text: On the 12th of [[Rabi al-Awwal|ربيع الأول]] in the year of the elephant, [[Am al-Fil|عام الفيل]].

And the [[Am al-Fil|عام الفيل]], we spoke about that before, that was the year that the incident happened where [[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]] came from [[Yemen|اليمن]] to destroy the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]], and how Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] destroyed [[Abrahah|أَبْرَهَة]] and his army, and He protected His house, He protected the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]].
So that was the year where [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ was born on the 12th of [[Rabi al-Awwal|ربيع الأول]],

according to the most authentic opinion. And there is some [[ikhtilaf|اختلاف]] on the date of his birth, not all of the [[ulama|علماء]] are agreed that he was born on the 12th of [[Rabi al-Awwal|ربيع الأول]], but perhaps it is the strongest opinion that he was born on Monday, the 12th of [[Rabi al-Awwal|ربيع الأول]].
